form.name: Name or nickname
form.nameHelp: Shown only to you. A nickname is fine.
form.guardian: I am their parent or legal guardian, and I am adding them so I can plan their outfits.
form.childPrivacy: Children never sign in. Nothing about them is sent to the AI except descriptions of their clothes: not their name, age or colouring. Delete them at any time and everything goes with them.
form.formality: How dressed-up do they like to be? ({value}/10)
form.fit: How do they like clothes to fit? (optional)
form.colouringMinor: Used only by the app's own colour rules to favour shades that suit them. It is never sent to the AI.
form.colouringAdult: Lets the stylist favour colours that suit them near the face.

manager.addedDescription: Switch to them from the top of the page to add their clothes.
manager.sheetDescription: Someone you dress who doesn't sign in: a child, or an adult without an email. They get their own wardrobe and outfits.
manager.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes {name}'s {count, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}}, their photos and all their outfits and plans. It cannot be undone.

roleHelp.manager: Can add and edit the children's clothes, and plan family looks.
roleHelp.viewer: Can see the family's outfits and plan family looks, but not change anything.

family.shareOnJoin: Let this family see my own wardrobe and outfits
family.nowShared: Your wardrobe is shared with this family
family.nowPrivate: Your wardrobe is now private to you
family.shareSelf: Let this family see my own wardrobe and use it in family looks
family.invitationSent: Invitation sent to {email}. They'll see it in Settings when they sign in.
family.inviteLabel: Invite someone with an Aether account
family.leaveDescription: You will no longer see or edit this family's people and outfits. Your own wardrobe is not affected. They can invite you again.
family.removeDescription: They will no longer see or edit your family's people and outfits. Their own wardrobe is not affected. You can invite them again.

errors.notOnAccount: That person is not on your account.
errors.accountNotSetUp: Your account is not set up yet.
errors.cannotAddToFamily: You can't add people to that family.
errors.familyFull: A family can have at most {max} people.
errors.couldNotAdd: Could not add this person. Please try again.
errors.couldNotSave: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.couldNotDeletePhotos: Could not delete their photos, so nothing was deleted. Please try again.
errors.couldNotDeleteProfile: Their photos were removed but the profile could not be deleted. Please try again.
